# TikTok
> TikTok is a short-form video platform with products for creators, advertisers, merchants, developers, and users, plus safety, privacy, and policy resources.

TikTok operates consumer, business, commerce, creator, and developer experiences across its main app and related platforms. Its public web presence includes business marketing resources, ads and commerce documentation, developer docs, newsroom updates, transparency and safety information, and legal and privacy materials.

## Main Platform
- [TikTok Home](https://www.tiktok.com/): Main consumer platform for discovering short-form videos, creators, trends, and entertainment.
- [Explore](https://www.tiktok.com/explore): Discovery surface for trending topics, hashtags, creators, and popular content.
- [Upload](https://www.tiktok.com/upload): Web interface for uploading and publishing videos to TikTok.
- [TikTok Studio](https://www.tiktok.com/tiktokstudio): Creator tools for content management, analytics, and workflow support.
- [Creator Academy](https://www.tiktok.com/creator-academy/): Educational resources for creators on content strategy, production, and platform best practices.

## TikTok for Business
- [TikTok for Business](https://www.tiktok.com/business/): Central hub for TikTok advertising, marketing solutions, and business products.
- [Ads Manager](https://ads.tiktok.com/): Campaign management platform for creating, running, and optimizing TikTok ads.
- [Business Help Center](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/): Support center for advertisers covering setup, billing, policy, and troubleshooting.
- [Business Learning Center](https://www.tiktok.com/business/learning-center/): Guides and training materials for advertisers and marketers using TikTok products.
- [Business Inspiration](https://www.tiktok.com/business/inspiration/): Case studies, campaign examples, and creative inspiration for brands and agencies.
- [Business Solutions](https://www.tiktok.com/business/products): Overview of TikTok advertising formats, tools, and business solutions.

## Advertising Products
- [Advertising Solutions](https://www.tiktok.com/business/products): Overview of ad formats and campaign solutions for different marketing goals.
- [Creative Center](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/creativecenter/): Research and inspiration tools for ad creatives, trends, and top-performing content.
- [Top Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/creativecenter/topads): Searchable library of notable ad creatives and campaign examples.
- [Trend Discovery](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/creativecenter/inspiration/popular/trends): Trend research for hashtags, songs, creators, and emerging content patterns.
- [Commercial Music Library](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/creativecenter/music/pc/en): Licensed music library for business and advertising use on TikTok.
- [Instant Page](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/instant-page?lang=en): Help documentation for TikTok’s native landing page ad experience.

## Commerce and Shopping
- [TikTok Shop](https://www.tiktok.com/shop): Shopping destination for products, merchants, and in-app commerce experiences.
- [TikTok Shop Seller Center](https://seller.tiktokglobalshop.com/): Merchant portal for managing products, orders, promotions, and shop operations.
- [TikTok Shop Academy](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/home): Training resources for sellers on store setup, operations, and growth.
- [TikTok Shop Partner Center](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/): Portal for service partners supporting merchants with commerce operations and growth.
- [TikTok Shop Affiliate](https://affiliate.tiktokglobalshop.com/): Affiliate tools connecting creators and sellers for commerce collaborations.
- [Shop Help Center](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/home?identity=1): Seller support and educational resources for TikTok Shop users.

## Developers
- [TikTok for Developers](https://developers.tiktok.com/): Developer platform for building integrations with TikTok products and services.
- [Developer Documentation](https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/): Technical documentation for TikTok APIs, SDKs, and integration workflows.
- [Login Kit](https://developers.tiktok.com/products/login-kit): Authentication product for signing users in with TikTok accounts.
- [Share Kit](https://developers.tiktok.com/products/share-kit): SDK and tools for sharing content to TikTok from external apps.
- [Display API](https://developers.tiktok.com/products/display-api): API for accessing approved TikTok profile and content display data.
- [Content Posting API](https://developers.tiktok.com/products/content-posting-api): API for publishing content to TikTok from third-party applications.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/webhooks-overview): Documentation for event notifications and webhook-based integrations.

## Creators and Partnerships
- [Creator Marketplace](https://creatormarketplace.tiktok.com/): Platform for brands and creators to discover, connect, and collaborate.
- [Creator Marketplace Help Center](https://creatormarketplace.tiktok.com/help-center): Support resources for using TikTok Creator Marketplace.
- [Creator Academy](https://www.tiktok.com/creator-academy/): Official learning resources for creators growing on TikTok.
- [TikTok Studio](https://www.tiktok.com/tiktokstudio): Tools for creators to manage content, insights, and publishing workflows.
- [Effect House](https://effecthouse.tiktok.com/): Platform for building augmented reality effects and interactive experiences for TikTok.
- [Effect House Documentation](https://effecthouse.tiktok.com/learn/guides): Guides and learning resources for creating and publishing TikTok effects.

## Safety, Transparency, and Community
- [Safety Center](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/): Central resource for user safety tools, controls, and educational materials.
- [Transparency Center](https://www.tiktok.com/transparency/en-us/): Information on moderation, security, privacy, and platform governance practices.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.tiktok.com/community-guidelines): Rules governing acceptable content and behavior on TikTok.
- [Youth Safety and Well-Being](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/families/): Family-focused safety resources, parental controls, and youth well-being information.
- [Privacy Center](https://www.tiktok.com/privacy/en/): Explanations of privacy features, controls, and user data practices.
- [Law Enforcement Guidelines](https://www.tiktok.com/legal/report/law-enforcement?lang=en): Information for law enforcement requests and legal process handling.

## Privacy and Legal
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tiktok.com/legal/privacy-policy): TikTok’s privacy policy describing data collection, use, and sharing practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.tiktok.com/legal/terms-of-service): Legal terms governing use of TikTok’s platform and services.
- [Intellectual Property Policy](https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/global/copyright-policy/en): Policy covering copyright, trademarks, and intellectual property reporting.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.tiktok.com/community-guidelines): Platform rules for content moderation, safety, and user conduct.
- [Legal Reporting Portal](https://www.tiktok.com/legal/report/feedback): Entry point for legal, policy, and reporting-related requests.
- [Accessibility](https://www.tiktok.com/accessibility/en/): Information about accessibility features and inclusive product design efforts.

## Newsroom and Corporate
- [TikTok Newsroom](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/): Official announcements, product updates, policy news, and company communications.
- [Company News](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/): U.S. newsroom archive for corporate updates and major announcements.
- [Safety News](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/tag/safety): Newsroom posts related to safety, trust, and platform integrity.
- [Creators News](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/tag/creators): News and announcements focused on creators and creative communities.
- [Business News](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/tag/business): Updates related to advertisers, brands, and business products.
- [TikTok Careers](https://careers.tiktok.com/): Careers site for roles across engineering, operations, policy, and business teams.
